title: AC add batch
description: Input for the Discord command /ac add_batch. The document is a JSON array; each entry records that a student solved an existing problem. The student must have access to the problem's class. All targets are validated before writes; new users and ACs are persisted together, and ACs that already exist are skipped.

user_id.description: Positive Discord user ID as a JSON string; it must fit uint64. Use users[].userId from the class export when available. Students without ACs are not in the export; ask the mentor for their IDs.

problem_id.description: ID of an existing solved problem (problems[].id in the class export). If the problem is new, create it first and refresh the class export after successful confirmation and use the assigned ID.
